# Metric Coverage Audit — Feature 002 Phase 6 Gate

**Feature**: 002-external-integration-foundation (US-12, T008, T158)
**Date**: 2026-04-13
**Status**: Live (auto-generated by `tests/observability/test_metric_coverage.py`)

## Summary

Every Prometheus metric in `src/dk_data/observability/metrics.py` MUST be:

1. **Defined** in `metrics.py`
2. **Emitted** from at least one production code path (`.inc/.set/.observe`)
3. **Consumed** by at least one Grafana dashboard panel or alert rule

This is the three-way binding principle — see `.dk/memory/principles.md §6`.

The CI check in `tests/observability/test_metric_coverage.py` enforces
(1) and (2) on every PR. It fails the build if a metric is defined
without an emission call. Dashboard coverage (3) is a softer check —
the test reports orphan metrics but currently allowlists them so the
cleanup can proceed incrementally.

|---|---|---|
| Defined in metrics.py | 78 | `grep '^[A-Z_]\\+ = (Counter\\|Gauge\\|Histogram)' src/dk_data/observability/metrics.py` |
| Emitted from production code | 41 | Out of 78 — 37 are currently on the T111/T112 cleanup ratchet |
| Consumed by a dashboard panel | 48 | Out of 78 — 30 are currently on the T111/T112 cleanup ratchet |

The test file tracks the precise ratchet; this audit document is the
human-readable snapshot used for Phase 6 gating.

## Ratchet policy

The EMISSION_ALLOWLIST and DASHBOARD_ALLOWLIST in the test file are
**allowed to shrink only, never grow**. Removing an entry means:

- Delete the metric definition from `metrics.py`, OR
- Wire up a real emission call site (T109/T110), OR
- Add a dashboard panel that queries the metric (T112)

Adding a new entry requires explicit review — the three-way binding
principle means a new dead metric should never land.

## Re-audit procedure (T158)

At the start of Phase 6 (and again every 2 weeks during feature 002
execution), re-run the check:

```bash
cd /Users/pschloz/Desktop/DataKinetic/dk-data-FE
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/observability/test_metric_coverage.py -v -o addopts=""
```

If any metric fails (i.e., any dead metric NOT already in the
ratchet list), the PR that introduced it MUST be fixed before merge.

If the ratchet list has shrunk since the last audit, update this
document with the new count and celebrate — every metric removed from
the ratchet is either wired up or deleted.
